name: Fortress of Death
summary:
Captured behind enemy lines, you wake in the gatehouse of the Fortress of Death, the Hornguard's mountain stronghold. The only way out is through it.

Fortress of Death is a first-person shooter in the spirit of the early-90s classics, rebuilt for virtual reality. The rules are old-school: fast floors, keys and locked doors, hidden walls that slide away, treasure to find and a tally at every exit. The fortress is fully 3D around you.
